customManagers.description: The pinned claude CLI. Renovate bumps the version only; the cli-pin workflow fails until scripts/cli-checksums.sh has written the checksums.
The Argo CD version of the kind testbed.

packageRules.description: A new CLI version needs its checksums: the maintainer runs scripts/cli-checksums.sh. Do not merge it by itself.

The preset 10.x needs conventional-changelog-writer 9, which the semantic-release 25 plugins do not ship yet (they use 8): the release notes fail with 10.x. Lift this when the plugins move to writer 9.
The release tooling moves together: one pull request for semantic-release and its plugins, never merged by itself.
The release tools run with a write token: a freshly published npm version is not proposed for a week.
